title: Settings
subtitle: Two-factor (TOTP), language, consent and your data.

totp.title: Authenticator (TOTP)
totp.enabled: TOTP is enabled for this account.
totp.alreadyEnabled: TOTP is already enabled for this account, so no new QR code is shown.
totp.notEnabled: TOTP is not set up yet. Payments of any size need it.
totp.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…).
totp.code: Enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator secret

language.title: Language
language.help: English is the official language. Chinese (简体中文) covers the dashboard, agent, approvals and audit log; other screens stay in English.

consent.title: Consent (PIPL-style)
consent.help: Stored on this device only in this demo. You can change these at any time.
consent.sensitive: I consent to processing my fee notices (may contain sensitive personal information) to plan payments.
consent.crossBorder: I acknowledge the cross-border data transfer notice: data stays in the sandbox/offline demo and is never sent abroad here.
consent.llm: Allow the optional LLM adapter to see tokenised, synthetic data (default off).

data.title: Your data
data.exportHelp: Downloads your audit events with hash-chain verification.
data.eraseHelp: Erases your account data (PIPL erasure). Audit entries keep hashes only.
data.eraseConfirmBody: This deletes your account and cannot be undone. You will be signed out.

demo.title: Demo controls (mock mode only)
demo.help: Shorten the 24-hour cooling-off so the approval can be shown in the demo.

notice: All data is synthetic. Bank is a sandbox. Setu never holds funds.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.help: Choose a light or dark theme, or follow your device setting.
